loc: Choose by luminance, not by the token name
text: Inspect the kit's real foreground and background values before assigning them. `$surface.brand` can be pale yellow, bright cyan, or deep purple: its name does not tell you whether it needs dark or light text. … The kit's declared on-color pairing is a starting point to check, not proof.
If the available combination fails, change the foreground, use a quieter approved surface, or add a deliberate plate/scrim. Check the resulting pixels again.

A monochromatic composition can work through differences in lightness, scale, texture, and spacing. Several same-family areas are not automatically a failure. … When two saturated areas fight, soften one, put a neutral between them, or give them more space.
Body copy and CTA labels need at least 4.5:1 contrast. Prefer 4.5:1 for the main headline too; 3:1 is only the absolute large-type floor
For a photograph or generated image, evaluate the actual region beneath each text run and logo, including any scrim. A dominant-color average cannot establish local readability.
